title: Common problems
summary: Quick fixes when the game does not start, join or run well.

sections.heading: The game crashes on start
steps: Try Safe mode. It joins once with the Burning Empires core only and does not change your setups.
If Safe mode works, click Find the crashing mod. It starts the game with half of your extra mods at a time until one is left.
Answer if the game reached the main menu each time. Then turn the mod it names off and click Save mods.
Still crashing? Click Check mods, then Install or repair Burning Empires.

sections.heading: The server turns the join down
steps: If it says a mod does not match the server, you and the host have different mods or versions.
Pick the same setup as the host. Share mod list and Import mod list help you match.
If the launcher says Harmony, ButterLib, UIExtenderEx or MCM differ from the host's, let Steam update the first three and get the host's MCM from Nexus Mods.
If it says the server password is wrong, ask the host for the password again.
If it says it could not finish joining, check the address and that UDP 4200 is open on the host.
sections.tip: The launcher warns you when you join a host with other mods than last time.

sections.heading: Odd screens or graphics
steps: Parts of the map can show black terrain. This is a known Burning Empires issue, not a problem with your game.
Population and religion screens can be out of date until you rejoin the server.
Graphics look wrong? Close Bannerlord, open the Settings page and click Clear shader cache.
The game builds the shaders again on the next start, so that start is slower. Saves are not touched.

sections.heading: Get help
steps: Click Send my logs on the Play page or on Logs and help. You see every file first, then you get a short code like CR-7KQ2M. Saves are left out.
Post only that code in Discord, not the log files.
If Windows blocked a DLL, click Connect again. If it comes back, open the Settings page and click Unblock DLLs.
